svg.title: On-chain MRV register, architecture and data flow
svg.desc: Three actors on the left drive three numbered on-chain processes inside a permissioned network: register facility, submit commitment, attest. Consumers read the attested record. Below, an off-chain domain holds sensor data, the Python pipeline and the report with its salt; only a hash crosses upward into the commitment, while the report and salt pass off-chain to the verifier.
svg.text: Raw data and reports stay here
